english.title: Provide money or property to person other than candidate or agent for purpose of meeting election expenses
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were guilty of illegal practice in that you provided

(A)_[money,]_
(B)_[property,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY AMOUNT OF MONEY OR TYPE OF PROPERTY..), other than to a candidate, namely **(..SPECIFY CANDIDATE..), or

(C)_[his]_
(D)_[her]_

election agent for the purpose of meeting the election expenses incurred by or on behalf of that candidate at an election, namely **(..SPECIFY ELECTION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 71A(3) and 169 of the Representation of the People Act 1983.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
provided money or property other than to a candidate or his election agent
for the purpose of meeting the election expenses incurred by or on behalf of a candidate at an election

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale.Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex see section 176Note
On the 12th March 2015, the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' Court was removed - as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
